Inclement weather policy
Given our location on an Arctic island, weather is a factor we must always consider. Occasionally, when fierce winds sweep in from the Atlantic, access to Littleisland Lighthouse may be temporarily restricted for safety reasons. Rest assured, such instances typically last no more than a day, happening no more than 3 to 4 times annually.
In the rare event that bad weather affects your planned arrival, resulting in boat transfer issues, we will refund 50% of your stay and assist in finding alternative accommodation until the storm subsides.
For air travellers, we strongly suggest booking flexible tickets which can be changed to accommodate for potential weather issues on your arrival day. Alternatively, we advise keeping a day or two open before and after your stay at the island. As a quayside stopover, we recommend an overnight stay at Skagakaia on route to the lighthouse.

About Litløy Fyr - Littleisland Lighthouse
0
….Elena Hansteensen arrived in Vesterålen, Northern Norway, and was captivated by the natural beauty and rich history of Litløya – Littleisland . In 2006, she purchased Litløy Fyr – Littleisland Lighthouse . With the vision of making it accessible to the public and began its renovation.
Today, Elena lives on the island, where she offers accommodation, day visits and various activities – including micro-weddings and other events.

The Friends Association
The Friends Association of Littleisland Lighthouse is a non-profit organization supporting the preservation of Litløya. Their work enables access to the island’s nature and culture for everyone who comes here.
